accounting_rule: Add external phase processes once, the original inner representation search once, and historical acquisition components once. Do not add nested attempt process, parent-loop, worker, application, fit, validation, or candidate timings. The3.85s focused test overlaps full preflight and is not additive. Reporting/package receipts remain separate.
interpretation: Partial sum of recorded nonoverlapping components, not complete end-to-end elapsed study wall or fully loaded development cost. External intervals were checked for overlap; search/acquisition components have distinct earlier scopes without complete enclosing clocks.
unmeasured_or_not_added: Historical sensor collection and author feature extraction
Unmeasured reporting/packaging or other helper work
Separately displayed report/package costs whose overlap is not certified
